title: From an event to a sentence
subtitle: Keep roles straight, choose a starting point, and notice what a sentence leaves unstated.

lessons.title: Same event, different subject
lessons.summary: Separate the doer from the grammatical subject, then compare active and passive forms.

lessons.title: When the sentence leaves somebody out
lessons.summary: An omitted doer is unstated, not nonexistent. Choose whether naming them helps the reader.
